title: Ops Lead / Superintendent Playbook
short_answer: You own production across jobs: who goes where, whether prep is real, when to pull a crew, and when standing-by becomes a documentation event.
summary: You own production across jobs: who goes where, whether prep is real, when to pull a crew, and when standing-by becomes a documentation event.
plain_words: You own production across jobs: who goes where, whether prep is real, when to pull a crew, and when standing-by becomes a documentation event. Morning Brief / route / prep status are side chat or DM — never Slack #operations .
when_to_use: When the job calls for ops lead / superintendent playbook
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting

steps.title: Read prep across today's jobs
steps.body: material, access, scaffold/heat notes from Job Start, open questions still unanswered.

steps.title: Huddle / assign from the private brief
steps.body: do not broadcast route sheets to #operations.

steps.title: Unscheduled work last unless a hard stop (inspec
steps.body: Unscheduled work last unless a hard stop (inspection, owner walk) forces a reorder — and then document why.

steps.title: Protect Job Check truth
steps.body: do not advance stages to calm a GC; send the lead to QC Walk first.

steps.title: Standing-by / stacked trades: treat as documenta
steps.body: Standing-by / stacked trades: treat as documentation events (Change Order page) — hours, crew, reason, same day.

steps.title: Pull criteria: unsafe access, incomplete handoff
steps.body: Pull criteria: unsafe access, incomplete handoff packet, rated work without a clear assembly, or a stop condition from Safety Orientation.

steps.title: Escalate money/scope to the office; keep owner e
steps.body: Escalate money/scope to the office; keep owner exceptions rare (Escalation Ladder).

common_mistakes.title: Advance stages on hope
common_mistakes.wrong: Mark complete without a real walk
common_mistakes.right: QC walk before Job Check moves
common_mistakes.why: Lies in Monday become field surprises

common_mistakes.title: No daily plan
common_mistakes.wrong: Crew starts without a clear first task
common_mistakes.right: Lead-day rhythm — who, where, what first
